content: धृतिं कृ .²1 To keep ground, to stand still; इतश्चेतश्च धावन्तो नैव चक्रुर्धृतिं रणे <ls>Mb. 7. 114. 101</ls>. .²2 To find pleasure or satisfaction.
धृतिं बन्ध् .²1 To show firmness; मानं धत्स्व धृतिं बधान ऋजुतां दूरे कुरु प्रेयसि <ls>Ak. 70</ls>. .²2 To fix the mind on; यद्ध्यायति यत्कुरुते धृतिं बध्नाति यत्र च <ls>Ms. 5. 47</ls>.

बन्ध् €9 <ab>P.</ab> (बध्नाति, बबन्ध, अभांत्सीत्, भंत्स्यति, बन्द्धुम्, बद्ध; {%<ab>pass.</ab>%} बध्यते) .²1 To bind, tie, fasten; बन्द्धुं न संभावित एव तावत् करेण रुद्धोऽपि च केशपाशः <ls>Ku. 7. 57</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 7.">25</ls>; <ls>R. 7. 9</ls>; <ls>Bk. 9. 75</ls>. .²2 To catch, capture, imprison, ensnare, make captive; कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते <ls>Bg. 4. 14</ls>; बलिर्बबन्धे <ls>Bk. 2. 39</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">14. 56</ls>. .²3 To chain, fetter. .²4 To check, stop, suppress; as in बद्धकोप, बद्धकोष्ठ <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 To put on, wear; न हि चूडामणिः पादे प्रभवामीति बध्यते <ls>Pt. 1. 72</ls>; बबन्धुरङ्गुलित्राणि <ls>Bk. 14. 7</ls>. .²6 To attract, arrest (as eyes <ab>&c.</ab>); बबन्ध चक्षूंषि यवप्ररोहः <ls>Ku. 7. 17</ls>; or बध्नाति मे चक्षुः (चित्रिकूटः) <ls>R. 13. 47</ls>. .²7 To fix or set upon, direct towards (as the eyes or mind), cast upon (with <ab>loc.</ab>); दृष्टिं लक्ष्येषु बध्नन् <ls>Mu. 1. 2</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 4</ls>, <ls n="R.">6. 36</ls>; <ls>Bk. 20. 22</ls>. .²8 To bind or fasten together (as hair); पूर्णप्रतिज्ञेन मया केवल बध्यते शिखा <ls>Mu. 7. 17</ls>. .²9 To build, construct, form, arrange; बद्धोर्मिनाकवनितापरिभुक्तमुक्तम् <ls>Ki. 8. 57</ls>; छायाबद्धकदम्बकं मृगकुलम् <ls>Ś. 2. 6</ls>; तस्याञ्जलिं बन्धुमतो बबन्ध <ls>R. 16. 5</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 38</ls>, <ls n="R.">11. 35</ls>, <ls n="R. 11.">78</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 47</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">5. 30</ls>; <ls>Bk. 7. 77</ls>. .²10 To put together, compose, construct (a poem, verse <ab>&c.</ab>); तुष्टैर्बद्धं तदलघु रघुस्वामिनः सच्चरित्रम् <ls>Vikr. 18. 107</ls>; श्लोक एवास्त्वयं बद्धः <ls>Rām. 1. 2. 31</ls>. .²11 To form, produce, bear (as fruit <ab>&c.</ab>); काले खलु समारब्धाः फलं बध्नन्ति नीतयः <ls>R. 12. 69</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 60</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>) <ls>Ś. 6. 3</ls>. .²12 To have, possess, entertain, cherish, feel. .²13 To punish, chastise. .²14 To offer, sacrifice (as an animal). .²15 To shut, close, stop. .²16 To oppress, overpower. .²17 To join, unite. .²18 To produce, cause, effect. .²19 To strike (as root). .²20 To display, exhibit, show. (The senses of बन्ध् are variously modified according to the noun with which it is connected; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} भ्रुकुटिं बन्ध् to knit or bend the eyebrows, to frown; मुष्टिं बन्ध् to clench the fist; अञ्जलिं बन्ध् to fold the hands together in supplication; चित्तं, धियं, मनः, हृदयं बन्ध् to set the heart on; प्रीतिं, भावं, रागं बन्ध् to fall in love with, be enamoured of; सेतुं बन्ध् to construct or build a bridge; वैरं बन्ध् to conceive hatred, contract enmity; सख्यं, सौहृदं बन्ध् to form friendship; गोलं बन्ध् to form a globe; मण्डलं बन्ध् to form a circle, sit or stand in a circle; मौनं बन्ध् to maintain silence; परिकरं, कक्षां बन्ध् to gird up oneʼs loins, prepare oneself for any thing; see the compounds under बद्ध also). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause to bind, form, construct, build <ab>&c.</ab>; स सेतुं बन्धयामास प्लवगैर्लवणाम्भसि <ls>R. 12. 70</ls>.
